title: Feedback Templates for Design Drafts
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting feedback templates for design drafts to the design-draft feedback template with criterion-location-action lines and one prioritized process-level move, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the design-draft feedback template with criterion-location-action lines and one prioritized process-level move shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
